actions.description: Copy a file to a destination
actions.name: copy-file

fileId.description: The ID of the file to copy. Example: "123abc"

name.description: The new name for the copied file. If not provided, the original name is used.

destinationFolderId.description: The ID of the folder where the copy should be placed. If not provided, the copy is placed in the same folder as the original.

id.description: The ID of the copied file

name.description: The name of the copied file

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the copied file

createdTime.description: The creation time of the copied file (RFC 3339)

actions.description: Add a comment to a file
actions.name: create-comment

fileId.description: The ID of the file to comment on. Example: "1zpWYuzY5S65OUGNBZQXmJf4FZnIWLJHBkC2xBamBzvw"

content.description: The plain text content of the comment. Example: "This is a test comment."

anchor.description: A region of the document represented as a JSON string for anchored comments. Example: "{\"r\":\"revision_id\",\"a\":[{\"line\":{\"end\":\"1\"}}]}"

content.description: The plain text content of the comment.

createdTime.description: The time when the comment was created (RFC 3339 date-time).

modifiedTime.description: The time when the comment was last modified (RFC 3339 date-time).

displayName.description: The display name of the author.

emailAddress.description: The email address of the author.

resolved.description: Whether the comment has been resolved.

deleted.description: Whether the comment has been deleted.

actions.description: Create a new folder in Google Drive
actions.name: create-folder

name.description: The name of the new folder. Example: "My New Folder"

parentId.description: The ID of the parent folder where the new folder will be created. If omitted, the folder is created in the root of the drive. Example: "1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms"

id.description: The unique identifier of the created folder.

name.description: The name of the created folder.

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the folder (always application/vnd.google-apps.folder).

createdTime.description: The timestamp when the folder was created.

actions.description: Create a shared drive
actions.name: create-shared-drive

name.description: The name of the shared drive. Example: "Project Resources"

requestId.description: A unique ID (such as a random UUID) that uniquely identifies this request for idempotent creation. A repeated request with the same request ID will not create duplicates.

actions.description: Delete a comment from a file
actions.name: delete-comment

fileId.description: The ID of the file containing the comment. Example: "1oD5i7NbLYQ6_mzEjNIXSqFvKXvvRNETwkfLrlDooFV0"

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to delete. Example: "AAAB1rDkxSA"

fileId.description: The ID of the file from which the comment was deleted

commentId.description: The ID of the deleted comment

actions.description: Delete a file or folder from Google Drive
actions.name: delete-file

fileId.description: The ID of the file or folder to delete. Example: "1aBcDeFgHiJkLmNoPqRsTuVwXyZ123456"

success.description: Whether the file was successfully deleted

fileId.description: The ID of the deleted file

actions.description: Remove a permission from a file
actions.name: delete-permission

fileId.description: The ID of the file to delete the permission from. Example: "1xJTXyJ1Pm1rK3Y9J1Y9J1Y9J1Y9J1Y9J"

permissionId.description: The ID of the permission to delete. Example: "12345678901234567890"

actions.description: Delete a shared drive
actions.name: delete-shared-drive

driveId.description: The ID of the shared drive to delete. Example: "0AP4r1ZoX57FvUk9PVA"

actions.description: Permanently delete all trashed files
actions.name: empty-trash

actions.description: Search for files by name or query in Google Drive
actions.name: find-file

query.description: Search query string. Uses Google Drive search query syntax. Example: "name contains 'report'" or "mimeType = 'application/pdf'". If not provided, returns all files.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (nextPageToken) from previous response. Omit for first page.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of files to return per page. Default is 100.

nextPageToken.description: Pagination cursor for the next page. Omitted if no more results.

totalResults.description: Total number of files returned in this page

actions.description: Search for a folder by name or query
actions.name: find-folder

name.description: Folder name or search query to find folders by name. Example: "Test Folder Alpha"

actions.description: Get the user's drive info and storage quota
actions.name: get-about

actions.description: Get the starting token for listing future changes
actions.name: get-changes-start-page-token

startPageToken.description: The starting page token for listing future changes

actions.description: Get a comment by ID
actions.name: get-comment

fileId.description: The ID of the file containing the comment. Example: "1abc123xyz"

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to retrieve. Example: "AAAB1p01B9w"

actions.description: Get a permission by ID
actions.name: get-permission

fileId.description: The ID of the file. Example: "1xABCDEF123456"

permissionId.description: The ID of the permission. Example: "12345678901234567890"

type.description: The type of the grantee. Valid values are user, group, domain, or anyone.

role.description: The role granted by this permission. Valid values are owner, organizer, fileOrganizer, writer, commenter, or reader.

emailAddress.description: The email address of the user or group this permission refers to.

domain.description: The domain to which this permission refers.

allowFileDiscovery.description: Whether the permission allows the file to be discovered through search.

displayName.description: A displayable name for users, groups or domains.

photoLink.description: A link to the profile photo, if available.

expirationTime.description: The time at which this permission will expire (RFC 3339 date-time).

permissionDetails.description: Details of the permission, including specific permissions and whether they inherited from a parent.

deleted.description: Whether this permission has been deleted.

pendingOwner.description: Whether the account associated with this permission has been deleted.

view.description: Indicates the view for this permission.

createdTime.description: The time at which this permission was created (RFC 3339 date-time).

actions.description: Get a file revision by ID
actions.name: get-revision

fileId.description: The ID of the file. Example: "1abc123xyz"

revisionId.description: The ID of the revision. Example: "1"

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the revision.

modifiedTime.description: The last time the revision was modified in RFC 3339 format.

keepForever.description: Whether this revision is marked as keep forever.

publishedLink.description: A link to the published revision.

publishedOutsideDomain.description: Whether this revision is published outside the domain.

size.description: The size of the revision in bytes.

originalFilename.description: The original filename of the revision.

md5Checksum.description: The MD5 checksum of the revision.

actions.description: Get a shared drive by ID
actions.name: get-shared-drive

id.description: The ID of the shared drive to retrieve. Example: "0ACo-2dj5Ql07Uk9PVA"

actions.description: Hide a shared drive from the default view
actions.name: hide-shared-drive

driveId.description: The ID of the shared drive to hide. Example: "0ABC123xyz"

actions.description: List changes to files and shared drives
actions.name: list-changes

pageToken.description: The token for continuing a previous list request. Omit for first request, in which case the action will get a start page token automatically.

driveId.description: The shared drive ID. If specified, changes will be limited to this drive.

includeItemsFromAllDrives.description: Whether to include changes from all shared drives. Default: false

includeRemoved.description: Whether to include changes indicating items have been removed. Default: true

pageSize.description: Maximum number of changes to return per page. Default: 100

actions.description: List comments on a file
actions.name: list-comments

fileId.description: The ID of the file to list comments for. Example: "1wwU5Dhr-6_3SHgtSQnXJ7HBPkgW-shalzdc0pfRL-Yk"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from previous response. Omit for first page.

nextPageToken.description: The cursor for the next page of comments. Omitted if there are no more pages.

actions.description: List immediate files and folders for a folder ID, or root when omitted, with cursor pagination and shared-drive support.
actions.name: list-files-non-unified

folderId.description: Folder ID to list contents. Omit for root folder.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (pageToken) from previous response. Omit for first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of files to return. Default: 100.

includeSharedDrives.description: Include items from shared drives. Default: false.

nextPageToken.description: Cursor for next page. Omitted if no more pages.

totalCount.description: Total number of files in this page.

actions.description: List permissions on a file
actions.name: list-permissions

fileId.description: The ID of the file to list permissions for. Example: "1AoQyTafvg1p_cqzJTTGmdbMTQ6jolnJ7J_mQBlPcFec"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from previous response. Omit for first page.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of permissions to return per page (1-100). Default: 100

actions.description: List shared drives the user can access, with cursor pagination and drive metadata like hidden, capabilities, and restrictions.
actions.name: list-drives

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from previous response. Omit for first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of shared drives to return. Default is 10, maximum is 100.

query.description: Query string for searching shared drives. Example: "hidden = false"

nextPageToken.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results. Omitted if this is the last page.

actions.description: Move a file to a different folder
actions.name: move-file

fileId.description: The ID of the file to move. Example: "1mD3ukEAmRqo8u0RF_Cr6IJl9f_uWTYH03vesDhB5Svw"

fromFolderId.description: The ID of the current parent folder. Example: "1SpnQKJHqNDh-qhbj_zGD2aIm-G-RKC_k"

toFolderId.description: The ID of the destination folder. Example: "1Bl1rB7hkBbdzmKUka3zSj0bhAK3pGypD"

actions.description: Restore a hidden shared drive to default view
actions.name: unhide-shared-drive

driveId.description: The ID of the shared drive to unhide. Example: "0ABC123xyz"

actions.description: Update a comment on a file
actions.name: update-comment

fileId.description: The ID of the file containing the comment. Example: "1mlzflxHXQkoCj-3p1T_O762TNAfGGr_iIb5C9uwnIwk"

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to update. Example: "AAAB1pvq854"

content.description: The new plain text content of the comment. Example: "Updated comment text"

resolved.description: Whether the comment is resolved. Optional.

actions.description: Update a file's metadata
actions.name: update-file

actions.description: Update a permission on a file
actions.name: update-permission

fileId.description: The ID of the file or shared drive.

role.description: The new role for the permission.

actions.description: Update a shared drive's metadata
actions.name: update-shared-drive

driveId.description: The ID of the shared drive to update. Example: "0AN1234567890XYZ"

name.description: The new name for the shared drive. Example: "Updated Shared Drive"

colorRgb.description: The color of the shared drive as an RGB hex string. Example: "#0000FF"

restrictions.description: Restrictions to apply to the shared drive

adminManagedRestrictions.description: Whether the restrictions are managed by an admin

copyRequiresWriterPermission.description: Whether the copy operation requires writer permission

domainUsersOnly.description: Whether only domain users can access the shared drive

driveMembersOnly.description: Whether only drive members can access the shared drive

actions.description: Upload plain text or base64 file content up to 5 MB, optionally into a folder with a description; defaults to root
actions.name: upload-document

name.description: The name of the file to create. Example: "document.txt"

content.description: The file content as plain text or base64 encoded string

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the file. Example: "text/plain", "application/pdf"

isBase64.description: Whether the content is base64 encoded. Defaults to false

folderId.description: The ID of the folder to upload the file into. If not provided, defaults to root. Example: "1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h"

id.description: The ID of the created file

name.description: The name of the created file

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the file

webViewLink.description: A link for opening the file in a relevant Google editor or viewer

webContentLink.description: A link for downloading the content of the file in a browser

syncs.description: Sync file metadata for IDs in connection metadata files, or recursively for all files under folder IDs in folders. Supports shared drives.
syncs.name: documents

files.description: Array of file IDs to sync directly

folders.description: Array of folder IDs to sync recursively

syncs.description: Sync root-level Google Drive folders from My Drive and shared drives
syncs.name: folders

syncs.description: Sync file permissions from Google Drive
syncs.name: permissions

syncs.description: Sync shared drives from Google Drive
syncs.name: shared-drives
